config.schema.image_not_pinned: {path}: the image "{value}" must be pinned by digest, for example registry/name:tag@sha256:<64 hex characters>.
config.schema.invalid_value: {path}: this value is not allowed. Allowed values: {allowed}.
config.schema.too_small: {path}: the value must be at least {minimum}.
config.schema.too_big: {path}: the value must be at most {maximum}.
config.schema.too_few_items: {path}: the list needs at least {minimum} item(s).
config.schema.invalid_time: {path}: "{value}" is not a time in HH:MM format.
config.schema.invalid_time_zone: {path}: "{value}" is not a known time zone.
config.schema.invalid_date: {path}: "{value}" is not a date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
config.schema.working_hours_order: {path}: the start time {start} must be before the end time {end}.
config.rule.g1_hitl: {path}: G1 must be HITL at every risk tier; found {found} for {tier} (rule {rule}, codes table §4).
config.rule.g7_hitl: {path}: G7 must be HITL at every risk tier; found {found} for {tier} (rule {rule}, codes table §4).
config.rule.g8_production_hitl: {path}: G8 in production must be HITL at every risk tier; found {found} for {tier} (rule {rule}, codes table §4).
config.rule.person_b_required: {path}: Person B must be an approver at {gate} (rule {rule}, codes table §4).
config.rule.critical_dual_approval: {path}: {gate} at Critical risk needs 2 approvals, from person_b and second_approver (rule {rule}, codes table §4).
config.rule.forced_hitl_flag_missing: {path}: the change flag {flag} must stay in the forced-HITL list for G3. You may add flags, not remove them (rule {rule}, codes table §4).
config.rule.dual_approval_flag_missing: {path}: the change flag {flag} must stay in the dual-approval list for G7. You may add flags, not remove them (rule {rule}, codes table §4).
config.rule.dual_approval_role_missing: {path}: the role {role} must stay in the G7 dual-approval roles (rule {rule}, codes table §4).
config.rule.g6_security_hitl: {path}: security findings at G6 must be HITL; found {found} (rule {rule}, codes table §4).
config.rule.g6_security_critical: {path}: the G6 security threshold {found} must include {severity} findings (rule {rule}, codes table §4).
config.rule.autonomy_above_mvp: {path}: autonomy {found} is above the MVP maximum {maximum} (rule {rule}, D-02 §4.2).
config.rule.autonomy_critical_l0: {path}: Critical risk must have autonomy L0; found {found} (rule {rule}, D-02 FR-03).
config.rule.autonomy_high_l1: {path}: High risk may have at most autonomy L1; found {found} (rule {rule}, D-02 FR-03).
config.rule.autonomy_order: {path}: {tier} risk may not have more autonomy than {lower_tier} risk (rule {rule}, codes table §3).
config.rule.routing_restricted_self_host: {path}: client_restricted data may use self-hosted models only (rule {rule}, D-07 §4).
config.rule.routing_prohibited_none: {path}: prohibited data may never be given to a model (rule {rule}, D-07 §4).
config.rule.budget_warn_max: {path}: the budget warning must come at {maximum} % or earlier (rule {rule}, D-07 §6).
config.rule.budget_stop_max: {path}: runs must stop at {maximum} % of the budget or earlier (rule {rule}, D-07 §6).
config.rule.budget_warn_before_stop: {path}: the budget warning must come before the stop (rule {rule}, D-07 §6).
config.rule.loop_max: {path}: loop detection must stop a run after at most {maximum} identical tool calls (rule {rule}, D-02 FR-35).
config.rule.calendar_min_working_days: {path}: the calendar needs at least {minimum} working days per week; found {found}. Fewer days would stretch SLA clocks (rule {rule}, codes table §6.3).
config.rule.calendar_min_working_hours: {path}: a working day needs at least {minimum} working hours; found {found} minutes. Shorter days would stretch SLA clocks (rule {rule}, codes table §6.3).
config.rule.sla_longer: {path}: the {clock} time for {severity} escalations may not be longer than {limit} (rule {rule}, codes table §6.3 and handbook Ch.6 §6.4).
config.rule.policy_only_g4: {path}: POLICY (automatic policy check) is allowed only at G4, not at {gate} (rule {rule}, codes table §4).
config.rule.policy_no_roles: {path}: a POLICY check has no human roles; remove them or choose another mode (rule {rule}).
config.rule.roles_required: {path}: at least one role is needed to approve, monitor or sample (rule {rule}).
config.rule.approvals_exceed_roles: {path}: more approvals are needed than roles are listed (rule {rule}).
config.rule.viewer_never_approves: {path}: the viewer role never approves or monitors a gate (rule {rule}, D-05 §5).
config.rule.on_breach_stricter: {path}: on_breach must be HITL; found {found} (rule {rule}, codes table §4).
config.rule.high_risk_hitl: {path}: {gate} must be HITL at {tier} risk, because high-risk effects always need human approval; found {found} (rule {rule}, codes table §4).
config.rule.g4_high_risk_hitl: {path}: G4 must be HITL at {tier} risk: permission before dangerous actions is never skipped; found {found} (rule {rule}, codes table §4).
config.rule.g6_independent_verification: {path}: G6 may not be a POLICY check at {tier} risk: independent verification is never skipped (rule {rule}, codes table §4).
config.warning.mode_loosened: {path}: oversight loosened from {from} (codes table default) to {to}. This change must be reviewed.
config.warning.g6_security_threshold_rai: {path}: G6 security threshold raised from {from} (default) to {to}, so fewer findings need a person. This change must be reviewed.
config.warning.approvals_reduced: {path}: approvals reduced from {from} (default) to {to}. This change must be reviewed.
config.warning.working_day_removed: {path}: {day} is no longer a working day, so working-time clocks (SLA, gate deadlines) run longer. This change must be reviewed.
config.warning.many_holidays: {path}: {count} holidays in {year} (more than {maximum}), so working-time clocks run longer. This change must be reviewed.
config.warning.contract_validity_long: {path}: Run Contracts stay valid for {minutes} minutes (more than {maximum}) between G4 and the sandbox start. This change must be reviewed.
config.warning.working_hours_shortened: {path}: a working day is now {to} minutes instead of {from}, so working-time clocks run longer. This change must be reviewed.
